name: IHSAA State Cross Country Finals
where: Terre Haute, IN · LaVern Gibson Championship Course
headline: IHSAA State Cross Country Finals
summary: Final: Fort Wayne Carroll won the boys title with 66 points to Carmel’s 105, and Springs Valley’s Calvin Seitz won the boys race in 14:34.7. Lake Central won the girls title with 136 points ahead of Homestead (151) and Carmel (176). Fort Wayne Concordia Lutheran’s Daphne Weller won the girls race in 16:52.2, ahead of Terre Haute North’s Addyson Bautista (17:06.8) and Hamilton Southeastern’s Anya Zoeller (17:08.0).
